text:
Marta: FYI night's billing-report job created 3 reversal credit memos in NetSuite that don't match Stripe. Not sure if it's proration or webhook replay.
Zane: Which accounts? any $ amount risk?
Marta: ACCT-512, ACCT-771, ACCT-914. Total ~ $945. ACCT-512 largest ($540). NetSuite reversal refs: RM-2026-512, RM-2026-771, RM-2026-914. Stripe shows only a prorate invoice for ACCT-512 but no reversal.
Priya: Can you paste the billing job log link + webhook sequence?
Marta: log: https://logs.example.com/org/finance/2026-03-24/jobs/8901
Marta: webhook payload sample: ```{
  "id":"evt_5L9a...",
  "type":"invoice.payment_succeeded",
  "data":{"object":{"id":"in_5L9a...","lines":[{"amount":-540,"description":"proration credit"}]}}
```
Zane: Nightly reporter does a netting step: it consumes webhooks and then runs ns-sync to materialize adjustments. I see events 8901/8902 replayed due to a transient Redis fail; our replay dedupe uses webhook_id only, but we also construct an adjustment id with invoice.number + job_id. If replay runs twice, ns-sync sees same invoice twice but different adjustment id so it creates a reversal.
Priya: So dedupe mismatch between webhook dedupe and ns-sync adjustment id generation. We need to prevent duplicate reversals immediately.
Netsuite-admin: I can mark the 3 reversal credit memos as "Pending Approval" and hold posting to GL until we confirm. Doing that now will stop cash impact. Will need finance sign-off to void >$500 (ACCT-512).
Marta: Please hold posting. Adding flags to records would be great.
Zane: Quick mitigation plan:
1) Pause nightly-report job (5m)
2) Patch ns-sync to use canonical adjustment id (invoice id only) when creating reversals (hotfix, ~20m)
3) Re-run reconciliation job in dry-run to confirm no extra reversals
4) After patch deploy, requeue replayed webhooks and let the idempotency flow take effect
Priya: I approve holding postings and void for ACCT-512 if needed. For ACCT-512, put a manual hold and I'll sign the void ticket after you confirm root cause.
Marta: Paused nightly-report at 2238005805.
billing-bot: job:billing-report-8901 paused by marta at 2238005805 :ok_hand:
Zane: Hotfix PR opened: fix/ns-sync-adjustment-id (link: https://git.example.com/r/redwood/ns-sync/pulls/411). CI pending.
Zane: Local test: when replay happens twice, with canonical id we only create one reversal. Good.
Netsuite-admin: I've set the three reversal memos to Pending and disabled auto-posting at 2238005850.
Marta: Running dry-run reconcile now.
Marta: Dry-run shows only 0 new reversals after patch applied locally.
Zane: Deploying hotfix to staging then prod. ETA deploy 20m.
Priya: Please also add a saved search for NS memos created by the nightly-report job and >$100 flagged; finance wants an email alert.
Netsuite-admin: Can add saved search and email alert. Will set to Priya + Marta.
Zane: After deploy I will requeue these specific webhook ids instead of full replay. Requeue command: `POST /webhooks/replay {ids:["evt_5L9a...","evt_5L9b..."]}`
Marta: Owners: Zane (code + replay), Netsuite-admin (hold + saved search), Priya (finance approval). Target timeline: patch + hold in place now; reconciled and cleared within 12 hours.
billing-bot: deploy:hotfix/ns-sync-adjustment-id pushed by zane at 2238005865, CI green :rocket:
Zane: Replayed only the two missing events to stripe->ns path. Monitoring now.
Marta: NetSuite posted one corrected adjustment and voided the phantom reversal for ACCT-512. Ledger now balanced.
Priya: Thanks team. Please file FIN-3470 with root cause and retrospective notes.
Marta: Filed FIN-3470 and attached logs. Closing thread once saved search email confirmed.
Netsuite-admin: Saved search/email set at 2238005888 to Priya and Marta.
Marta: "
